title: Carry / basis standalone
data_integrity_note: First attempt invalid (funding silently zero, SI-4). Corrected run uses 1h mark; spot-check trade funding (0.4259 USDT) matches an independent manual calculation.

definition.signal: sign of trailing 3-day mean funding rate
definition.sizing: 10% of equity per active pair (10 positions = 1x gross)
definition.stop: none by specification; exit is the funding-sign flip

key_findings: The strategy PAID funding in aggregate (full-sample funding PnL -11,306 USDT): it is not harvesting carry, its return is directional price exposure.
Validation strength (PF 2.41) rests on only 100 trades.
decision: FAIL. Carry as preregistered does not provide a robust standalone return: it failed out-of-sample and did not actually earn funding (net funding PnL negative). Not eligible for combination.
